# Sample documents (fictional)

The shared test, demo and store-screenshot documents (DK-0023). **Everything
here is fictional:** no real person, address, account, tax or ID number. The
people are Max Mustermann and Anna Beispiel, the address is Musterstraße 12,
80331 München, the IBAN is always `DE00 0000 0000 0000 0000 00`, the
Steuer-ID `00 000 000 000`, the phone `089 0000000`, and every email ends in
`example.com`. `tools/tests/test_make_fixtures.py` fails if a non-zero IBAN or
a non-example email shows up.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py` (reportlab, pypdf and Pillow, dev
tools only; none of them ships). Change the generator, not the PDFs, and
regenerate. The output is byte-identical on every run, except
`encrypted-aes256.pdf`, which gets a new random salt each time: commit it only
when its content changed.

| File | Pages | What it is | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Mietvertrag Musterstraße 12.pdf` | 3 | Rental contract (DE), text layer, bookmarks per §, IBAN and email | Viewer, search, merge (outline), redaction detection, AI summary, the design's default file |
| `Invoice INV-2026-014.pdf` | 1 | Invoice (EN), table, totals, IBAN | Tools, redaction, Ask your PDF, store screenshots |
| `Lebenslauf Max Mustermann.pdf` | 2 | CV (DE), date of birth, email, phone | Redaction (personal data), translate |
| `Finanzamt München – Bescheid 2025.pdf` | 1 | Tax assessment (DE), Steuernummer, Steuer-ID, IBAN | Redaction (Steuer-ID check digit), German content |
| `scanned-letters-bundle.pdf` | 6 | Three scanned letters (2 + 1 + 2 pages, a blank separator sheet after the second), JPEG pages, no text layer, slight skew and noise, "Seite x von y" and a different letterhead per letter | Smart Split, OCR PDF, OCR redaction, Compress |
| `form-acroform.pdf` | 1 | Fillable AcroForm: text fields, a dropdown, a radio group, two checkboxes | Fill forms, flatten |
| `form-xfa.pdf` | 1 | An XFA form (`/XFA` in the AcroForm, `NeedsRendering`); PDFium reports form type 2 | The "XFA forms aren't supported" message |
| `encrypted-aes256.pdf` | 1 | The invoice, AES-256 encrypted; user password **`dokulo`** (a test value, not a secret) | Unlock, the password prompt, wrong-password errors |
| `damaged-xref.pdf` | 1 | The invoice with a wrong `startxref` and a zeroed xref table; repairable by rebuilding the xref | Repair PDF, the damaged-file error |
| `long-300-pages.pdf` | 300 | Text pages with a chapter outline every 25 pages and a unique search word per page (`Abschnitt001`…`Abschnitt300`) | Performance (merge 200 pages < 3 s), thumbnails, search, split |

Names with `ß`, `ü` and `–` are deliberate: file handling must cope with them.

## The golden corpus's base files (`corpus/`, DK-0658)

What the samples above don't cover, generated by the same script. The suite
in `packages/doc_tools/test/corpus/` turns them and the samples into variants
with qpdf at test time (linearized, object streams, uncompressed, rotated,
AES-128 and AES-256 owner-only and RC4-40 encrypted, truncated, merged,
PDF/A-2b): about 30 files in the gate, 160 with `DK_CORPUS=full`.

| File | Pages | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `non-latin.pdf` | 2 | Greek, Cyrillic, Polish, Czech, Turkish, Vietnamese in an embedded Roboto subset |
| `page-sizes.pdf` | 6 | A4, US Letter, A3 landscape, A5, US Legal, a 140 mm square |
| `rotated-pages.pdf` | 4 | `/Rotate` 0, 90, 180, 270; the last two with a CropBox inside the MediaBox |
| `images.pdf` | 2 | A JPEG photo, a PNG with alpha, a CMYK JPEG, greyscale, a 1-bit bitmap |
| `links-annotations.pdf` | 2 | An outline, an internal and a web link, a highlight, a note, a free-text comment |
| `incremental-update.pdf` | 1 | The invoice with an appended revision (its own xref and trailer, `/Prev`): a new title |
| `extreme-pages.pdf` | 3 | A 5 × 5 m page (too big for a phone: "tooLarge"), a 25 mm page, an empty page |
| `vector-heavy.pdf` | 1 | 6,000 strokes and 400 semi-transparent circles |

No CJK or right-to-left text yet: the repo has no permissive font for them.
